title: Stop Chasing CVEs: Start Governing Software Dependencies
content_md: A new vulnerability disclosure can set off a familiar chain of work. You check whether or not an application uses the affected component, determine whether the vulnerable code is reachable, find a fixed version, test the upgrade, and get it into production. Then the next advisory arrives. Article Link: Stop Chasing CVEs: Start Governing Software Dependencies
exclude_reason: Generic explainer on dependency governance; not a security event.
